snippet.title: Carnival Hunt | Intro | Kickstarter
snippet.description:
It's been 6 amazing days since we launched our Kickstarter and we are already 73% funded! Can't imagine this journey without our community. Please watch this video to see part of our journey and meet the creators of this Mongolia's first 3d multiplayer game.
